description:
Get the todoTask resources from the tasks navigation property of a specified todoTaskList.

💡 TIP: Lists tasks in a To Do list. Requires todoTaskList-id — use list-todo-task-lists to find it. Use $filter=status eq 'notStarted' or $filter=status eq 'completed' to filter by status. Use $top to limit results. Status values: 'notStarted', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'waitingOnOthers', 'deferred'. $orderby works on createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, importance, status and reminderDateTime/dateTime, not on title or isReminderOn. A $filter on isReminderOn can also return 400; filter it client-side.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure indication

expand.description: Navigation properties to inline, e.g. attachments on a message or event. Only navigation properties can be expanded: expanding a non-navigation property such as a message body fails with "Parsing OData Select and Expand failed". Some APIs accept only one relationship per request, so prefer a single value. Some relationships support nested selection, e.g. children($select=id,name).

fetchAllPages.description: Follow @odata.nextLink and merge up to 100 pages into one response. Can return enormous payloads—only when the user explicitly needs a full export. Prefer a small $top first, then paginate or narrow with $filter.

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata

skiptoken.description: Next page: the @odata.nextLink from the previous response. Keep the other arguments the same.

todoTaskListId.description: Value for the 'todoTaskListId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'todoTaskListId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the todo task list object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (e.g. 5–15) so responses fit the model context; raise only if needed. For more rows, use @odata.nextLink from the response instead of a very large $top.
